CLM-MAT-0418.statement: The periodic area of the Σ5(310)[001] grain boundary in SrTiO3 is 48.41 Å2.

extra_quotes: Here, we combine the Grand Canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) method with a universal machine-learning interatomic potential to explore the coupled compositional and structural phase space of Σ5(310)[001] SrTiO3 grain boundaries.
For the uMLIP energy evaluation and structural relaxation, we employed the Equiformer V2 86M model46 (eqV2-M), whose architecture is based on the Transformer model.

To assesstheaccuracyoftheuniversalpotential, weconductedDFTcalculationsbyVASPfor these 280 structures (details in Supplemental Material) and compared the resulting energies and atomic forces with those predicted by eqV2-M.
